libraryPreparationPreflight.agent_guidance: When configuring Confluent schema serializer/serde classes, include `schema.registry.url=mock://<unique-test-scope>` in the config map. Prefer `MockSchemaRegistryClient` or the `mock://` pseudo-protocol for local coverage; do not require a real Schema Registry Docker service unless verification proves the mock path is insufficient.
risks: The artifact is a base schema serializer module; concrete Avro/JSON/Protobuf serializers live in sibling artifacts, so tests should avoid depending on those unless intentionally broadening coverage.

Some formatter/reader classes may touch Kafka tooling APIs; focus first on schema-id serializers, subject/context strategies, wrapper serializers, and config behavior covered by transitive dependencies.
libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: No extra Maven dependency or Docker image is needed; meaningful tests can use the artifact's built-in mock Schema Registry support instead of a live Kafka/Schema Registry service.
